meta_title: Rough Game · Pump It Up score tracker
meta_description: A fast, good-looking score tracker for Pump It Up Phoenix 2: imports, top 50 exports, profiles and stats.
footer_tagline: Made by players, for players. Free and ad-free.
footer_unofficial: Unofficial fan project. Not affiliated with Andamiro.
hero_subtitle: Import from the official site, share a gorgeous top 50, and dig through every score you've ever played. Fast profiles, zero clutter.
plates_caption: From Rough Game to Perfect Game, every plate counts.
features_subheading: The boring parts are automatic, so you can get back to the pad.
feature_import_body: Link your piugame account and hit Import. Daily auto-scans catch the sessions you forget about.
feature_top50_body: Share-ready images of your PUMBILITY top 50 with your own colours, layout and fields.
feature_profile_body: Rating, favourite titles and pinned scores on a page worth sending to friends.
feature_fast_body: Profiles are precomputed and served from the edge, so they load instantly.
feature_filter_body: Slice all your scores by level, type, version, BPM, artist, grade, plate and more.
feature_stats_body: Grade and plate breakdowns per level, plus how your rating moves over time.
promise_body: Rough Game is a community tool. No paid tiers, no ads, and your data stays yours.
